title.value: Performative Prediction in Time Series: A Case Study
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the paper's central focus on the phenomenon of performative prediction within time series data, specifically applied to a healthcare setting.
title.quote: Performative Prediction in Time Series: A Case Study

extractions.description: The paper studies performative prediction in time series data within the context of monitoring and predicting cancer patient symptoms. It explores how predictions can influence future data and outcomes, posing a challenge in accurately forecasting future symptom values. The authors propose methods to mitigate performative prediction effects and measure their impact using patient data from a cancer center.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper addresses healthcare and utilizes predictive modeling, it does not focus on climate or ecological sustainability. Its primary objective is to improve healthcare prediction systems, particularly for oncology patients.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we represent patient-reported symptom values collected during their oncology appointments as a time series.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any listed Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development categories. Its focus on healthcare and time series prediction doesn't align with the specified sustainable development areas.
